args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

The docstring and FIN-212 require ROUND_HALF_EVEN, but the
implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP. This caused the nightly build
failure in tests/test_money.py.

args.head: fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
`src/money.py`'s `round_money` documented banker's rounding per FIN-212 but actually called `quantize` with `ROUND_HALF_UP`. This broke the nightly build (`tests/test_money.py` expects `2.665 → 2.66`, which only holds with ROUND_HALF_EVEN).

## Changes
- Import and use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passes.
